headline: La Nación / IMF and World Bank Open Annual Meeting in Bangkok Amid Energy Crisis and AI
summary: The IMF and World Bank opened their annual meetings at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Center in Bangkok. The agenda is shaped by an energy crisis and artificial intelligence.
why: The IMF and World Bank are the main multilateral lenders and economic surveillance bodies, and their meetings shape global policy on growth, debt and financing.
